payload.title: Automatic DIP workflow with one finish call and gated rollout
payload.description: Implement the user-approved automatic workflow plan: preserve intent, requests, native plans, coordination and remaining work while reducing model management overhead. Compare exact installed baseline with candidate, retain all failures and a private rollback package. Exclude Dan accessibility work. Full contract and measurements are linked documents. Originating user request tracked as task_8eca0bb71cda597a6e4e75f0c675f74366fbc6472faac655372c93bdb05aed76 in the host project.
acceptance: Requests stay outside work backlog until promoted; writes coordinate; one finish can pause without false completion.
Startup context <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, routine receipts <=1024 bytes; preserve ledger and user-edited integrations.
Conservative read grammar, no routine integration repair, shared task read, durable recorder recovery and exact evidence reuse.
Behavioral/package/browser regressions pass; 12 bounded native model turns and real workflow must satisfy rollout gate before global upgrade.
